risks.description: Manual B-Rep implementation of Boolean operations (UNION, INTERSECT, DIFFERENCE) in TypeScript.
risks.impact: High risk of topological invalidity, non-manifold results, and numerical non-convergence in complex geometric tangency or near-coincidence cases.
risks.mitigation_status: NONE (Custom logic prone to O(N^2) complexity and epsilon-based instability).

risks.description: Polyhedral stubs for analytical curved primitives.
risks.evidence: BRepKernel.createSphere() and BRepKernel.createTorus() implement polyhedral extrusions of circular polygons instead of true analytical or NURBS-based curved surfaces.
risks.impact: Inaccurate surface area and volume calculations; inability to perform precise FEA/CFD on curved boundaries.

risks.evidence: STEPAP242Translator.ts uses JSON.stringify/parse instead of ISO 10303-21 parser/generator.
risks.impact: Total failure to interoperate with external CAD systems (SolidWorks, CATIA, NX) despite claims of STEP AP242 support.

risks.evidence: OcctKernelAdapter exists but is unlinked; node_modules/opencascade.js is absent from the filesystem.
risks.impact: The system relies on 'BRepKernel.ts' (custom TS) which lacks the 30+ years of numerical hardening present in OCCT.

risks.description: Lack of spatial partitioning for topological queries.
risks.evidence: Topology checks and intersection logic use direct array iterations without BVH, Octree, or R-Tree indexing.
risks.impact: Exponential performance degradation as feature count and polygon density increase.

limitations.details: NURBS basis functions and evaluators exist in src/engine/cad-kernel/nurbs but are not integrated into the main BRepKernel pipeline.
Constraint propagation uses simple graph traversal; missing a robust non-linear solver for multi-dimensional geometric constraints.
